answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 58765 Country: MY Title: Charity to Non-muslim neighbours Question: I found on my way to office a man asking monetary help from people. But I am in doubt about his religion. My heart goes for him. And sometimes I give him. Is it ok? Answer ID: 58765 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 560/558/H=06/1436) If you doubt about a person’s religion, but his condition shows that he is a needy person then it is lawful to give him financial help. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
